# Vendored MuJoCo WebAssembly

`mujoco_wasm.js` is the `mujoco-js` 0.0.7 distribution from
https://www.npmjs.com/package/mujoco-js, vendored so the GitHub Pages demo does
not depend on a third-party CDN at startup.
